problems.description: Users receive deceptive emails that mimic trusted organizations, prompting them to click malicious links or provide sensitive information such as credentials or financial data.
risk_reduction: Implement advanced email filtering and anti-spam solutions
Conduct regular user awareness training and phishing simulations
Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce credential misuse

problems.description: Targeted phishing attacks aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization, often using personalized information to increase credibility and success rate.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted campaigns
Train high-risk users on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Deploy endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools to detect suspicious activity

problems.description: Phishing attempts conducted via SMS messages that lure victims into clicking malicious links or revealing personal information through text messages.
risk_reduction: Educate users about risks of unsolicited SMS links
Implement mobile device management (MDM) with security policies
Use SMS filtering and anti-spam tools on mobile devices

problems.description: Attackers intercept unencrypted communications over public or unsecured Wi-Fi networks to capture sensitive data such as login credentials or personal information.
risk_reduction: Enforce use of VPNs when accessing public Wi-Fi
Ensure all sensitive communications use strong encryption (TLS)
Disable automatic connection to open Wi-Fi networks on devices

problems.description: An attacker downgrades a victim’s HTTPS connection to HTTP, intercepting and potentially altering data transmitted between the user and the website without detection.
risk_reduction: Implement HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) on web servers
Use up-to-date TLS configurations and certificates
Educate users to verify HTTPS and certificate warnings in browsers

problems.description: An attacker sends falsified ARP messages on a local network to associate their MAC address with the IP address of another device, enabling interception or modification of network traffic.
risk_reduction: Deploy dynamic ARP inspection (DAI) on network switches
Use static ARP entries for critical devices where feasible
Monitor network traffic for unusual ARP activity and anomalies
